title: Within-group proportion heatmap with complete grid and exact percent labels
source_relation: adapted: function-style contract, mapped-value inspection instead of image comparison
difficulty_hypothesis: Agents normalise by region or by the grand total, drop empty combinations (so zero tiles vanish), round labels to whole percents, or let unused factor levels and NA rows distort the axes.

mcp_relevance.rationale: Normalisation margin and a complete grid are data-wrangling semantics; no package, version or documentation fact is decisive.

blockers: ceiling effect likely for strong baselines: calibration must confirm
